Local corresponding source
==========================
The adjacent corresponding-source.tar.gz contains actual complete upstream
source trees, not only download links. It includes the npm package manifest,
entry points and license; upstream build, bundling and CI scripts; libheif's
post.js wrapper; libde265's generated configure/build files; the complete
Emscripten 3.1.61 runtime and system libraries; and the emsdk 3.1.61 installer.
All upstream sources and their per-file notices are retained unmodified.
UPSTREAM-ARCHIVES.json inside the archive records measured archive hashes.

Build and bundle instructions
=============================
These commands describe the upstream build from the included sources. They
were source-inspected, not executed as part of this vendoring operation.
Use an isolated Linux build directory with Node.js 24, npm, Python 3, CMake,
Make, autoconf, automake, libtool and a C/C++ toolchain. The SDK installation
fetches the standard unmodified Emscripten compiler toolchain; it is not a
runtime decoder dependency. The included Emscripten source tree supplies the
runtime sources and notices matching that SDK version.

  tar -xzf corresponding-source.tar.gz
  cd corresponding-source
  ./emsdk-3.1.61/emsdk install 3.1.61
  ./emsdk-3.1.61/emsdk activate 3.1.61
  . ./emsdk-3.1.61/emsdk_env.sh
  npm install -g typescript@5
  mkdir build-wasm
  cd build-wasm
  tar -czf libde265-1.0.15.tar.gz -C .. libde265-1.0.15
  ENABLE_LIBDE265=1 LIBDE265_VERSION=1.0.15 ENABLE_AOM=0 \
    ENABLE_WEBCODECS=0 ENABLE_UNCOMPRESSED=0 ENABLE_OPENJPEG=0 \
    USE_WASM=1 USE_TYPESCRIPT=1 USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0 \
    ../libheif-413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00/build-emscripten.sh \
    ../libheif-413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00
  cd ..
  mkdir -p decoder-dist/libheif-wasm
  cp build-wasm/libheif.js build-wasm/libheif.wasm \
    build-wasm/libheif.d.ts decoder-dist/libheif-wasm/
  cp libheif-413e2a87e6a70b3eccc3a3adc5801179dd2d9e00/COPYING \
    decoder-dist/libheif-wasm/LICENSE
  tar -czf decoder-dist.tar.gz -C decoder-dist libheif-wasm
  cd libheif-js-d8ec4bc3bc5bf8055975577bccbbc7e1d7313c2d
  npm install --ignore-scripts
  node scripts/install.js ../decoder-dist.tar.gz

The output is libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js. scripts/install.js uses the
package's esbuild ^0.19.5 and esbuild-plugins-node-modules-polyfill ^1.6.7
build dependencies, targeting ES2019 and embedding WASM as binary. Upstream
does not include a dependency lockfile, so a new build is not claimed to be
byte-for-byte reproducible. The shipped bundle is the verified npm member,
not an unverified local rebuild. The original full release workflow is in
libheif-emscripten-*/.github/workflows/emscripten.yml and dist-prep.sh.

Replacing or modifying the decoder
=================================
The decoder is a separate replaceable file. Build an interface-compatible
bundle with the commands above, replace libheif-bundle.js beside this file,
and serve the application again. No signing key or application-code change
is required to replace this decoder. Its classic-script global is a callable
libheif factory; await libheif() returns the module exposing HeifDecoder.
The application wrappers remain separate from this vendor file. Application
source is distributed separately with Jizhang under its MIT license.

Licensing and attribution
=========================
LICENSES.txt reproduces the npm LGPL notice, libheif's combined LGPL-3.0 and
GPL-3.0 text and MIT examples notice, libde265's LGPL/GPL and utility notices,
and Emscripten/emsdk and applicable runtime notices verbatim. Runtime notices
include musl, compiler-rt, libc++, libc++abi, libunwind and mimalloc; the full
Emscripten source tree retains all other per-file/component notices, including
optional components not selected by this decoder build. LGPL permits library
modification and reverse engineering to debug those modifications subject to
its terms; this application imposes no additional restriction on that use.
Read the supplied license texts for the applicable terms and warranty
exclusions. No warranty is provided for this decoder.
